text: OVERDOSAGE Following single or repeated intranasal applications of BACTROBAN NASAL to adults, no evidence for systemic absorption of mupirocin was obtained. Intravenous infusions of 252 mg, as well as single oral doses of 500 mg of mupirocin, have been well tolerated in healthy adult subjects. There is no information regarding local overdose of BACTROBAN NASAL or regarding oral ingestion of the nasal ointment formulation.
